name: Falling in love with the Word
promise: Six days for anyone who struggles to read the Bible, on keeping the word, feeding your spirit and learning to think in Scripture.
why: Many believers love God and still struggle to open His book. The problem is rarely appetite alone: the word must find good ground, the spirit must be fed like a newborn, and the mind must be calibrated by Scripture until God's voice is easy to recognise. These six sessions treat reading that way. The word kept with patience, study that rightly divides, a hearing made safe by the written word, and food strong enough for the journey, until the voice of Scripture becomes the clearest sound in your life.

days.theme: Good ground: keeping the word with patience
days.key_quote: At the end of the day, He will ask you: did you keep my word?

days.theme: Fed on the Word: a robust and healthy spirit
days.key_quote: If your spirit man is not healthy, your spirit man is not robust and strong, you're going to lose a lot on spiritual resources.
If you are going to rightly divide the word of truth, you will need to take exaggerations out.
You are safer reading your Bible and obeying it.

days.theme: Spiritual food for a journey too great for you
days.key_quote: If you don't know spiritual food, there is no way your spirit can prosper.

days.theme: Thinking in Scripture: His voice becomes clear
days.key_quote: It is when you now understand the voice of Scripture that you can understand the voice of God.
